title: GE to Buy Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B
summary: Bloomberg's Kiel Porter joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." GE Aerospace agreed to buy castings manufacturer Consolidated Precision Products from Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11.75 billion, a deal that will significantly expand the jet-engine manufacturer’s capacity for the critical components. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump’s Latest Trade Threat Weighs on Canadian Firms With US Contracts
summary: Shares of Canadian companies that do business with the US government fell following President Donald Trump’s threat to bar Canadian-origin products from being sold to federal contractors.

title: Copper Hits Fresh All-Time Highs in New York and London
summary: Copper climbed to a fresh record in London and New York as traders weighed persistent tariff fears and supply shortages against escalating hostilities in the Middle East that clouded demand outlook.

title: Comcast Slides After CFO Says Broadband User Losses to Persist
summary: Comcast Corp. shares slid Wednesday after Chief Financial Officer Jason Armstrong said he sees no improvement in broadband subscriber losses in the current quarter, a sign competitors are offering lower prices that lure customers away.

title: Bessent Triples Debt Buyback But Market Shows Disappointment
summary: The US Treasury tripled the initial size of its next buyback of longer-dated government debt, in an announcement that was met with disappointment by investors who had expected an even larger increase.

title: US Sees Diesel Stocks Falling to 2003 Low Ahead of Peak Demand
summary: US diesel stockpiles are projected to fall this month to their lowest level in over two decades, according to a new government report, as wars around the world, including one launched by Washington, choke flows from key export hubs.

title: Treasuries Extend Drop After New Buyback Targets Disappoint
summary: US government bonds fell after the Treasury Department announced target sizes for its expanded buyback program short of the levels some strategists said were possible.

title: Oil Tops $100 on Supply Fears,  Apple Faces a Big Test

Plus, Vale CFO Marcelo Bacci on resilient iron ore demand, and Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon exits with a stark warning over AI risk. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Firms Unleash Record Wave of Bond Sales in Europe
